notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[p]Hello Pilots!
[/p][p]This latest patch brings some fixes, balance changes and some requested features.

But there is still a lot more balance changes coming in the coming weeks![/p][p][/p][p]Change list:[/p][list][*][p]Soft locking issues fixed in previous hotfixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with corrupted save game files[/p][/*][*][p]Improved 10%+ fps performance[/p][/*][*][p]Field Inversion is now Epic, so it’s harder to get and more expensive to buy[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the buying price of some of the equipment[/p][/*][*][p]You no longer lose the spear when you don’t retrieve it at the end of a fight[/p][/*][*][p]Max fps set to 160[/p][/*][*][p]You can now target enemies in their portraits as an alternative to clicking them on the map[/p][/*][*][p]Boss Sahaquiel can now be damaged by more melee weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Some elite enemies now deal more damage while doing charges[/p][/*][*][p]Added more fights for Act I and II[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: The Pilot Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello Pilots!
[/p][p]With the [b]‘Pilot Update[/b]’ we finally add pickable pilots with specific bonuses for each.[/p][p]You need to unlock the pilots, in the same way you unlock the new Mechs, by just playing! [/p][p][/p][p]We are still testing things out so expect many changes in the coming month.[/p][p]There will also be a new roadmap and upcoming features for the final 1.0 release.[/p][p][/p][p]Change log:[/p][list][*][p]3 pickable Pilots: Nicole, Grav and Eugenica[/p][/*][*][p]2 New cards: Energy Beam and ARC Cross. They will still need new gfx and art that will be added later[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed all Evacuation cards to either cost 0 and/or draw a card.[/p][/*][*][p]Dogma maneuver buffed 1 dmg and 1 shield gain[/p][/*][*][p]Shotgun now costs 1 down from 2[/p][/*][*][p]Power Absorption range increased[/p][/*][*][p]Added new art on some research icons[/p][/*][*][p]Improved highlights when you draw a card from an equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Added a decoration building ‘Torre de Belém’ to the Nova-Lisbon Act.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes and balances[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: Research Update is now live!
notes.content:
Hello Pilots!

With the '[b]Research Update[/b]' we bring two new features to the game.

[list]
[*] Research tab - You can now upgrade your mech via the research tab, specializing your mech into specific mechanics. You will gain resources by killing the archangels and use them in the research tab.
[*] Pilot selection menu - This is just a preview since you can only choose Nicole as a pilot, but you will see some of the new pilots that will be introduced later this summer
[/list]

This is just the first batch of research upgrades, with around only 30% of the planned upgrades, and we will implement them slowly as we balance the game in other areas.

There are also some minor ui improvements and other fixes.

And this is just the start of the update as we are pushing more content and new assets in the coming weeks, so stay tuned!

Thank you!

notes.title: Impact Update
notes.content:
Hello Pilots!

The 'Impact Update' is now live!
Once you finish the game in regular mode the Impact mode is unlocked and offers a bigger challenge with harder enemies and a total of 5 Acts for each run.

There are 12 Impact levels at the moment with increasing difficulty for each one.
For each level the enemies can gain additional energy, number of moves, or even an extra enemy spawn on each fight.
The cost of repairs and max HP upgrades are also increased.

Since we are still testing things out, these will probably change drastically in the coming weeks as we balance things out.

Once we have a more final difficulty curve we will detail all the changes for each impact level.

Let us know in the steam forums if you find any issue or difficulty is too high or low.

In the next few weeks we will push new balances, new ui improvements and there are a couple of new bosses that will be added to the game.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patch 0.6.1
notes.content:
Hello Pilots!

We did some minor improvements and changes:

- Added new animation and background when you enter a new Act.
- Increased repair cost from 150 to 200 credits.
- Increased max hp upgrade from 500 to 600 credits.
- Added a new game mode option that will be available soon!
- Minor bug fixes

We plan to release the new game mode next week.
The 'Impact' mode will unlock once you finish the 'regular' game mode.
It will have tougher enemies and will be a longer run with 5 Acts.

We will share more details once it's done.

Thank you!

notes.title: Ophanim Update is now Live!
notes.content:
Hello pilots!

With this update we are adding a new boss, enemies and a new card and some balance changes.

There will also be more regular updates later this month with more bosses and other improvements.

[list]
[*] New boss Ophanim added to Act I 
[*] Added new versions of some elite enemies like Turiel and Adriel.
[*] Now regular enemies only do one action per turn, so it’s more clear what enemies will do next turn.
[*] For elite or bosses there can still be more than one attack per turn and we added some UI changes to make it more clear, but more improvements will be done soon.
[*] Added new card, Cascading Resonance. Be careful because in certain maps, a badly placed attack with this card can destroy most of the city. Just make sure people have evacuated safely!
[*] Berserk mode has been buffed, now giving +10HP and more battery.
[/list]

We will continue to make some changes on how enemy intents work.
This current version does make the game a bit easier on the regular fights and more balances will be added in the coming weeks.

There is also a new harder mode that will be unlocked via the 'arc pass' or by finishing the game in the regular mode. This new game mode should be available before the end of this month.

Thank you for your support, see you soon!

notes.title: Pinnacle Update
notes.content:
Hello Pilots!

The 3rd playable Mech is now live, the Pinnacle Mecha uses drones to gain shields and deliver powerful blows to the enemy.
You can unlock it in the last level of the 'Arc Pass' (no microtransactions involved).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797562/ccffdbf773504a0539288414fbc4336197a9e4ca.gif[/img]

There are still many things that will be polished and probably many balancing changes in the coming weeks. 

We will also give an update to our roadmap soon detailing the next content we have planned.

Here is the change list:

[list]
[*] New mech: Pinnacle
[*] Several new cards added, you just have to check them out!
[*] Improvements and changes to some UI elements
[*] New gfx added, from drones to more rewarding ‘hit’ effects
[*] New elite enemy Raziel, still under testing
[*] New music tracks!
[*] We temporarily removed one of the first bosses, it just wasn’t working properly and we will take some time to make the fight more interesting

notes.title: 0.5.7 - Boost Update
notes.content:
Hello Pilots!

With the 'Boost Update' we did some core changes and added new cards and equipment.
You will now have an equipment by default that gives you a free movement card, so you can get faster to where the fight is. But only at the start of each combat!

Here are some of the new cards added:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797562/f1289a347f0ddffc842b619a7b0126ced89359a6.png[/img]

The new common equipment cards give bonus relative to your regular move actions. 
Some of them might be overpowered when used together, but we will address this later as we do more play testing.

All the changes:

[list]
[*] Added 5 new common cards: Tactical Analysis, Launch Boost, Staccato, Crushing Blow and Photon Beam
[*] New Equipments: Move Cycler, Move Synergy, Hydraulic Bypass, Battery Overcharge
[*] Added a new default equipment (Battery Overcharge)  that spawns new card at start of combat
[*] New small maps added to Act I and Act II for more engaging combat
[*] Kinetic Shields cost reduced to 1
[*] Minor changes to the player and enemy stats bar
[*] Fixed an uncommon bug that locked your cards
[*] New gfx: Now helicopters move around at the start of the combat
[/list]

We also plan to do bigger changes to how the enemy intent actions work, maybe later this week.

Thank you!

notes.title: Draft Update
notes.content:
Hello Pilots!

This is our first content update, introducing a new game mode and some visual improvements.
And there is still a lot more planned for the coming weeks.

In Draft Mode you choose one card in one pack, that contains 10 cards, and then get to receive more packs until you complete a deck with 10 cards. Each pack will have the rarest card removed on each pick.
This means each time you play a draft game you get to create a unique powerful starting deck.

Here is the change list:

[list]
[*] The Draft Mode is now available! Build your deck from rotating card packs.
[*] New cutscenes added!
[*] You can now view the whole game card library in the main menu.
[*] Some Acts will now be longer.
[*] Each Act will only have 1 equipment reward now.
[*] There are now arrow indications for the player mech location and enemies.
[*] Better indications when you have adjacent buildings that are blocking you.
[*] Anti Field cost reduced to 0
[*] Minor balance stuff
[/list]

notes.title: Demo is now available!
notes.content:
ARC SEED is part of the Dinos vs Robots Fest!

So we have just released an updated demo for you to try it out.

It's still a work in progress so:

[list]
[*] Only one Mech available
[*] 7 fights with one final boss
[*] Limited number of cards and equipment
[*] Some things will be missing, like incomplete animations, lack of tooltips for game mechanics and other stuff

notes.title: Demo patch
notes.content:
Hello!
We pushed a new update to the demo, fixing some of the issues players reported.

This is an early alpha so expect a very limited game experience with a lot of missing elements.

[list]
[*] Fixed some bugs, including one where your mech sprite could be swapped by one of the enemies.
[*] Improved visibility on the selectable squares
[*] Added some missing sounds and gfx
[*] Added new tracks and improved existing background music
[*] We noticed many players not understanding the battery stats, so we increased the starting values. You need to charge your battery in the charging points before you run out! (we will explain this better in a future tutorial)
[*] Fixed other minor bugs
[/list]

That's it for now, a big thank you to everyone who submitted feedback!

notes.title: Alpha Demo is now available!
notes.content:
ARC SEED is part of this year Next Fest June 2023!

We had an issue with the demo yesterday but it should be fully playable now!

This is just a sneak peak of the game and base mechanics.

Since it's an early build expect some things to be missing, but here are some important points:
[list]
[*] You will do 3 sequential fights, some elements are randomized.
[*] You start with a basic deck and your equipped weapons will 'spawn' a card each 2 turns.
[*] The enemies have simple abilities, in the final game each Archangel can be quite different and the strategy used to fight them will be very different.
[*] You can do repairs and upgrade some stats on your mech
[*] Each time you get a new card you need to check the 'deckbuilder' tab before each fight and put the card in your deck. 
[*] You have a minimum deck size of 7! When in the deckbuilder, you cannot proceed if your deck is smaller than that.
[*] Watch out for your available battery, the only way to recharge it is in the battery chargers, during the fights. At the moment we don't explain that clearly in the demo tutorial.
[/list]

We already know about some bugs but let us know in the Steam Forums if you find anything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797562/9f4250f118f3894389f256108939a716300afae0.gif[/img]

Thank you!
